veg.make_ahead: Fry or bake fresh

steps.text: Boil six of the eggs for 6 minutes, cool and peel.
Squash the vegetarian sausage meat together, wrap a portion around each egg, then roll in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs.
Deep fry in the oil at 170C for 5 minutes, or bake at 200C for 20 minutes, until golden and hot through.
Halve to serve.

veg.make_ahead: Make fresh

steps.text: Slit the bananas lengthways through the top skin without cutting through the bottom and open slightly.
Stuff with chocolate and marshmallows. Wrap each in foil.
Cook on a barbecue or at 200C in the oven until melted.
Open the foil, scatter with crushed biscuits and eat with spoons.

veg.make_ahead: Skewer up to 4 hours ahead, grill fresh

steps.text: Thread the haloumi, onion and pineapple onto skewers.
Warm the honey with the chilli and lime juice.
Grill over hot coals, brushing with the glaze, until sticky and charred on all sides.

veg.make_ahead: Fill and pleat up to 1 day ahead, steam fresh

ingredients.item: soy sauce, plus extra for dipping

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in the oil until dry and browned, then cool.
Mix with the tofu, spring onions, soy and salt.
Fill the wrappers and pleat closed.
Steam in a lined bamboo basket and serve with extra soy, the black vinegar and chilli oil.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 4 hours, grill fresh

ingredients.item: lemons, one for the marinade and one for the sauce

steps.text: Toss the haloumi in the juice of one lemon with the garlic, oregano and oil and leave for 30 minutes.
Grill until golden and charred on each side.
Mix the mayonnaise with the zest and juice of the second lemon. Spear the haloumi on toothpicks and serve with the sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Slice the beetroot as thin as you can and toss with the lemon juice and salt.
Top the blinis with creme fraiche, a fold of beetroot and chives.
Peel the zucchini into long ribbons, brush with the oil and paprika and sear quickly in a hot pan. Cool.
Cut the rockmelon into neat wedges, remove the skin and wrap each with a zucchini ribbon.
Lay both out on trays in rows.

veg.make_ahead: Crumb up to 2 hours ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Cut the haloumi into thick fingers.
Dip each in beaten egg, then press into the mixed coconut and panko.
Fry in the oil at 180C for 2 minutes until golden and crisp, in batches.
Serve hot with the sweet chilli sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Fill up to 1 day ahead, boil fresh

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender, drain and mash.
Fry the mushrooms and onion in 20g of the butter until dry, then mix into the potato with the salt and pepper.
Fill the wrappers and pinch into little round parcels.
Boil until they float, then a minute more.
Melt the rest of the butter, toss the pelmeni in it with the dill and serve with plenty of sour cream.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 2 hours, grill fresh

ingredients.item: lemons, one zested and one juiced

steps.text: Halve the mushrooms lengthways, score the cut side and toss with the garlic, chilli, lemon zest and oil.
Grill over high heat for 3 minutes a side until charred and tender.
Pile onto a platter and serve with mayonnaise mixed with lemon juice.

veg.make_ahead: Bake a day ahead, decorate on the day

steps.text: Beat the butter and sugar, add the eggs and fold in the flour.
Bake in two round tins at 175C. Cool.
Cut one round into ears and a bow tie and assemble into a bunny.
Mix the icing sugar with a little water, cover the bunny and press on coconut. Add marshmallows.

veg.make_ahead: Make fresh

steps.text: Cut the cauliflower into large florets.
Toss with the oil and salt and roast at 220C until crisp and browned at the edges.
Melt the butter with the honey, garlic and thyme.
Toss the hot cauliflower through the glaze until shiny and golden and serve on a big platter.

veg.make_ahead: Wrap up to 1 day ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 6 minutes, cool and peel.
Mix the vegetarian sausage meat with the sage and wrap around each egg.
Roll in flour, beaten egg and panko.
Fry in the oil at 170C for 5 minutes, then halve and serve with mustard.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Spread the crispbreads with creme fraiche.
Top half with slices of smoked tofu and half with pickled beetroot.
Finish each with a sprig of dill and a few thin slices of red onion. Serve on a board.

veg.make_ahead: Chilli up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Finely chop the onions, keeping half aside raw for serving.
Simmer the plant-based mince with the onion, chilli powder, tomatoes and water, stirring now and then, until thick.
Split the sausages and grill until browned and hot.
Serve in the buns with the chilli, mustard and the raw chopped onion.

veg.n: Brooklyn bagel bites with carrot lox
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, assembled and chilled

steps.text: Peel the carrots into long ribbons, pour over boiling water, leave 2 minutes and drain. Toss with the oil, soy, paprika and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Split the bagels and toast until golden.
Mix the cream cheese with the lemon zest, dill and salt.
Spread thickly on each bagel half, then top with folds of carrot, thin rings of red onion and a few capers.
Finish with pepper and a little more dill.

veg.make_ahead: Spice mix up to 1 week, store airtight

ingredients.item: extra firm tofu, patted dry and cut into cubes

steps.text: Mix the ground peanuts with the paprika, ginger, chilli flakes and salt.
Thread the tofu onto soaked skewers, brush with the oil and coat all over in the spice.
Grill on high heat until charred.
Serve with sliced onion and tomato, sprinkled with more spice.

ingredients.item: curry powder, plus extra for dusting

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into fries, toss in oil and spread on trays.
Bake at 220C, turning once, until crisp.
Grill the vegetarian sausages until browned, then slice into rounds.
Warm the tomato sauce with the curry powder and paprika.
Pour over the sliced sausages, dust with curry powder and serve with the fries.
Cut the cauliflower into florets and whisk the cornflour and plain flour with the water into a thin batter.
Dip the florets in batter and fry in the oil at 170C in batches until pale golden, then rest on a rack.
Fry again at 190C until crackly and golden.
Warm the gochujang with the honey, garlic and soy until glossy.
Toss the cauliflower through the glaze and scatter with sesame seeds.

ingredients.item: large flat mushrooms, cut into thick strips

steps.text: Grind the peanuts with the paprika, ginger, chilli flakes and salt.
Brush the mushrooms with the oil, coat in the spice and thread onto skewers.
Grill hot until charred.
Serve with sliced red onion and tomato.

veg.n: School bus mushroom and cheese pizza scrolls
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat to serve

steps.text: Rub the butter into the flour, then mix in the milk to a soft dough.
Roll out to a 30 x 40cm rectangle and spread with tomato paste.
Scatter with mushrooms, cheddar and oregano, then roll up from the long side.
Cut into 12 slices and lay cut side up in a lined tin.
Bake at 210C until golden.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

ingredients.item: packets vegetarian jelly crystals (red, orange, green)

steps.text: Make up the red, orange and green jellies as the packets say.
Steep the pea flowers in the boiling water and strain. Bring the apple juice, the grape juice and the blue tea to the boil in separate pans, whisking 1 tsp agar into each, and simmer 2 minutes.
Divide the fruit between glasses by colour and pour the matching jelly over each.
Chill until set, about 2 hours.
Whip the cream with the vanilla and spoon on top to serve.

veg.make_ahead: Make the risotto up to 1 day ahead, fry just before serving

steps.text: Cook the rice with the hot stock and saffron into a risotto, stir in the cheese, then spread out to cool.
Chill overnight or at least a few hours until firm.
Roll into balls around cubes of mozzarella, coat in egg and then panko.
Fry in the oil at 180C in batches until golden all over.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, uncooked and chilled

steps.text: Toss the wombok with the salt, leave a few minutes and squeeze out the water. Crumble in the tofu and mix with the ginger.
Fill the wrappers and pleat closed.
Fry in oil until crisp underneath.
Add the water, cover and steam until hot through.
Serve with chilli oil and soy sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, uncooked and chilled

steps.text: Mix the paneer with the cabbage, spring onions, ginger, cumin and salt.
Fill the wrappers and pleat closed.
Steam in batches until hot through.
Roast the tomatoes, then blitz with the chilli and sesame seeds into an achar to serve alongside.

veg.n: Venice cicchetti, three toppings on toast (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Bean spread up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Toast the baguette slices with a little of the olive oil.
Blitz the beans with the rest of the olive oil and the garlic until creamy.
Spread a third of the toasts with the bean cream.
Top a third with ricotta and fig, and the rest with artichoke and parsley.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, uncooked and chilled

steps.text: Mix the tofu with the bean sprouts, carrot, onion, most of the garlic, the egg, soy and pepper.
Roll a thin line of filling in each wrapper, folding in the sides and sealing with water.
Fry in the oil at 175C until deep golden.
Serve with sweet chilli sauce and the vinegar mixed with the last of the garlic.

veg.n: Talokan lime hearts of palm tostadas
veg.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep chilled, pile onto tostadas just before serving

ingredients.item: can hearts of palm, drained and diced

steps.text: Cover the hearts of palm with the lime juice and leave for 15 minutes.
Drain and toss with the onion and coriander.
Spread smashed avocado on the tostadas and pile the hearts of palm on top just before serving.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day before baking, keep chilled

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry and cut into bite-sized pieces.
Dust in the flour mixed with the nori, dip in egg and press into the panko.
Spread on a lined tray, spray with a little oil and bake at 220C until golden.
Serve with tartare sauce. Keep them away from the cat.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat to serve

steps.text: Cut the pastry into rounds and press into a greased mini muffin tray.
Whisk the eggs and cream, then stir through the spinach, tomatoes and cheddar.
Fill the cases.
Bake at 190C until puffed and set.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

ingredients.item: packets vegetarian jelly crystals (raspberry, lime, blue, orange)

steps.text: Make up the raspberry jelly with half the usual water and pour a thin layer into clear glasses.
Chill until set.
Repeat with the lime, then blue, then orange jelly, letting each set before the next goes on.
Chill the finished glasses until firm.
Whip the cream and spoon on top just before serving.
Slice the beetroot very thin and toss with a squeeze of lemon.
Spread the crispbreads with creme fraiche.
Top with folds of beetroot, cucumber and a sprig of dill.
Squeeze over the rest of the lemon just before serving.

veg.n: Katy's family mushroom and tofu congee
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats with extra stock

steps.text: Rinse the rice and put in a big pot with the stock and ginger.
Bring to the boil, then simmer gently, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Stir in the mushrooms and simmer until soft, then gently add the tofu to warm through.
Ladle into bowls and top with spring onion, soy, sesame oil and fried shallots.

veg.make_ahead: Tofu can marinate up to 1 day

ingredients.item: extra firm tofu, cut into 1cm slices

steps.text: Mix the hoisin, honey, soy and garlic and coat the tofu.
Marinate in the fridge.
Roast on a lined tray at 200C, basting with the marinade twice, until sticky and charred.
Steam the bao buns.
Fill with tofu, cucumber, spring onion and peanuts.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Blitz two mangoes with the sugar into a puree.
Whisk the agar into the evaporated milk in a saucepan, bring to a simmer and cook for 2 minutes, stirring.
Take off the heat, stir in the puree and pour into glasses straight away.
Set in the fridge, about 2 hours.
Top with thin slices of the last mango laid like scales.

veg.make_ahead: Filling up to 2 days ahead

ingredients.item: 400g cans young green jackfruit in brine, drained

steps.text: Put the jackfruit in a pot with the chipotle, water and salt.
Simmer until soft and the liquid has cooked away, then shred with two forks.
Roll small amounts of jackfruit and cheddar in the tortillas, folding in the sides.
Fry in the oil seam side down until crisp all over.
Serve with sour cream and diced tomato salsa.

veg.make_ahead: Filling up to 1 day, fry fresh

steps.text: Brown the plant-based mince with the taco seasoning, add the refried beans and cool.
Fill the tortillas with the mix and cheese and roll tightly.
Fry in the oil seam down at 180C until golden.
Halve and serve with sour cream and salsa.

veg.n: Pentagon kitchen tomato soup and toasties (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Soup up to 2 days, toasties fresh

steps.text: Toss the tomatoes, onion and garlic in oil.
Roast at 200C until soft and browned.
Blend with the stock, sugar and salt, then reheat and stir in the cream.
Make cheddar toasties with buttered bread, cooking each side in a frying pan.
Cut into fingers and serve with the soup.
Melt the chocolate gently with the cream in a fondue pot or small pan.
Keep warm at the table.
Set out strawberries, marshmallows and cake for dipping on forks.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool in cold water, peel and halve.
Lay out the cheddar, eggs, pickled onions, chutney and apple on a board.
Add thick slices of crusty bread and a dish of butter.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day uncrumbed, chilled

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in 20g of the butter with the salt until dry and browned.
Melt the rest of the butter, stir in the flour and whisk in the milk until very thick.
Add the mushrooms and spread out to cool.
Chill overnight or at least a few hours until firm.
Shape into logs and crumb in egg and panko.
Fry in the oil until golden.

ingredients.item: extra firm tofu, patted dry and cut into pieces

steps.text: Toss the tofu in cornflour.
Fry in the oil in batches until crisp.
Warm the soy with the honey until bubbling and toss the tofu through.
Roll in black sesame seeds until coated and dark, and serve on toothpicks.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Blend the mango flesh with the sugar until smooth, keeping a few cubes aside.
Whisk the agar into the water in a saucepan, bring to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring.
Whisk in most of the evaporated milk and the cream, then the mango puree, and pour into glasses.
Chill until set, about 2 hours.
Pour a little of the last evaporated milk over each and top with the mango cubes.
Whisk the eggs with the milk, cheddar, spring onion and capsicum.
Pour into a greased 12-hole muffin tin.
Bake at 180C until puffed and set.
Serve warm.

veg.n: Midtown Science capsicum and olive pizza rolls
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day uncooked, chilled

ingredients.item: roasted red capsicum strips, from a jar

steps.text: Spread the pastry with pizza sauce, leaving a 1cm border, and scatter with capsicum, olives, mozzarella and oregano.
Roll each sheet up tightly.
Chill, then cut into 2cm slices.
Lay cut side up on lined trays, brush with egg and bake at 200C until golden.
Warm the passata and serve for dipping.

veg.n: Gwen's dark hot chocolate with marshmallow (vegetarian)

steps.text: Heat the milk until steaming but not boiling.
Off the heat, whisk in the chocolate, cocoa, sugar, vanilla and salt until smooth and frothy.
Pour into mugs, top with marshmallows and toast with a blowtorch or under a hot grill.
Cut the cauliflower into large florets and toss with the oil and salt.
Bake at 220C until crisp and browned at the edges.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce and honey and toss the cauliflower through.
Serve with the sour cream mixed with the herbs, and celery sticks to put the fire out.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Make up the jelly with a little less water than the packet says.
Pour a layer into a ring mould with sliced strawberries and grapes.
Chill until set, then fill with the rest.
Chill overnight.
Turn out and serve with whipped cream.
Dust the mushrooms in the flour mixed with the paprika and salt.
Fry in the oil at 180C in batches until crisp.
Drain on paper and serve with lemon wedges and tartare sauce.

veg.n: Food court sausage rolls and potato skins (vegetarian)

steps.text: Wrap the sausages in strips of puff pastry.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Bake the potatoes until soft.
Fry the mushrooms in the oil with the paprika and soy until dark and crisp.
Halve the potatoes, scoop out a little and fill with cheddar and the crispy mushrooms.
Grill until bubbling and serve both with sour cream.
Cut the haloumi into bite-sized fingers.
Whisk most of the flour with the lager to a thin batter.
Dust the haloumi in the rest of the flour, dip in batter and fry in the oil at 180C until crisp.
Drain and serve with lemon wedges and tartare.
Cut the haloumi into bite-sized fingers.
Whisk most of the flour with the soda water to a thin batter.
Dust the haloumi in the rest of the flour, dip in batter and fry in the oil at 180C until crisp.
Drain and serve with lemon wedges and tartare.
Cut the cauliflower into large florets and toss with the oil and salt.
Bake at 220C until crisp and browned at the edges.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce and toss the cauliflower through.
Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream and serve with celery.
Slice the mushrooms thinly.
Sear the mushrooms with the onion in the oil until browned, then add the soy.
Lay provolone over to melt.
Toast the buns and pile the filling on.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 week, keep chilled

steps.text: Melt the chocolate.
Stir through the marshmallows, almonds, biscuits and coconut.
Press into a lined tin, chill until set and cut into chunks.

veg.n: Iceberg Lounge beetroot rye and spiced olives

ingredients.item: large cooked beetroot, very thinly sliced

steps.text: Cut the rye into small squares, spread with creme fraiche and top each with a fold of beetroot.
Warm the olives in a pan with strips of orange peel and chilli flakes.
Serve both on a dark board.

veg.n: Daily Planet bagel bites with carrot lox

steps.text: Peel the carrots into long ribbons, pour over boiling water, leave 2 minutes and drain. Toss with the oil, soy, paprika and lemon juice.
Split and toast the bagels.
Spread with cream cheese and top with the carrot, capers, red onion and dill.

veg.n: Fortress crystal tofu rice paper rolls
veg.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, covered with damp paper towel

steps.text: Soak the vermicelli in boiling water, drain and cool.
Pat the tofu dry and cut into thin batons.
Dip each rice paper in warm water until pliable, lay flat, fill with tofu, noodles, cucumber and herbs, fold in the sides and roll tightly.
Mix the sweet chilli sauce with lime juice and soy sauce for dipping.

veg.n: Mr Freeze iced hearts of palm

steps.text: Cut the hearts of palm into thick rounds, pile crushed ice onto a platter and arrange them on top.
Mix the mayonnaise with tomato sauce, lemon juice and hot sauce.
Serve the sauce in a small bowl in the middle.
Cut the cauliflower into large florets and toss with the oil and salt.
Bake at 220C until crisp and browned at the edges.
Warm the butter with honey, soy sauce and chilli until sticky and toss the cauliflower through until glossy.

veg.n: Splinter's sewer lair spinach and olive rolls

steps.text: Roll the dough into a rectangle on a floured bench and spread with pizza sauce.
Scatter with mozzarella, spinach and olives and roll up from the long side.
Cut into twelve rolls and sit in a lined tin.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Cook the rice and season lightly with the salt.
Fry the mushrooms in the oil, add the soy and sugar and cook until sticky.
With wet hands, shape rice into triangles around a little of the mushroom.
Wrap the base in nori, sprinkle with sesame and serve with pickled ginger.
Simmer the soy, mirin and sugar until syrupy.
Thread the mushrooms and zucchini onto skewers.
Grill, brushing with the glaze, until sticky and charred.
Scatter with spring onion and serve hot.

veg_af.n: Time sceptre teriyaki mushroom skewers (vegetarian, alcohol-free)

steps.text: Simmer the soy, apple juice, rice vinegar and sugar until syrupy.
Thread the mushrooms and zucchini onto skewers.
Grill, brushing with the glaze, until sticky and charred.
Scatter with spring onion and serve hot.
Butter the bread on the outside and fill four sandwiches with cheddar and tomato.
Cook in a pan over medium heat, pressing down, until golden and melting.
Cut each into long soldiers and serve hot.

veg.n: Mr Glass lemon and berry jelly (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Whisk the agar and sugar into the water, bring to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring.
Take off the heat and stir in the juice of the lemons.
Divide the berries among round glasses and pour over the jelly.
Chill until clear and set, about 90 minutes.
Halve the mushrooms lengthways, score the cut side and toss with garlic, chilli, lime zest and melted butter.
Grill for 3 minutes a side until charred and tender.
Pile high on a platter with lime wedges and pour over any butter left in the pan.
Cut the cauliflower into large florets and toss with the oil and salt.
Bake at 220C until crisp and browned at the edges.
Warm the gochujang with the honey, garlic and soy until glossy.
Toss the cauliflower through and scatter with sesame seeds.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Melt the white chocolate.
Dip each marshmallow until fully coated and set on baking paper.
Melt the dark chocolate and pipe two small dots joined by a line on each for the face.
Leave to set.
Slice the baguette thinly and brush with some of the olive oil.
Toast at 200C until crisp.
Slice the eggplant thinly, brush with the rest of the oil and the paprika and chargrill until soft and smoky.
Top each toast with eggplant, a small slice of provolone and a strip of pickled capsicum, in rows on a board.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Crush the biscuits with the butter and press into a lined tin.
Whisk the agar into the water with the sugar, bring to the boil and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring, until syrupy.
Whip the egg whites to soft peaks, then pour in the hot syrup while beating and keep whipping until thick, glossy and white. Beat in the pink colouring.
Spread over the base straight away, dust with coconut and chill until set.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Slice the beetroot very thin and toss with the lemon juice.
Top the blinis with creme fraiche, a fold of beetroot and a sprig of dill.
Cut the rockmelon into wedges and remove the skin. Peel the cucumber into long ribbons and wrap one around each wedge with a mint leaf.
Arrange both on silver trays and serve chilled.

veg.n: Mermaid lagoon asparagus and hearts of palm
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Bring a pot of water to the boil with the salt and slices of one lemon.
Poach the asparagus for 2 minutes until bright green.
Plunge into a bowl of water with half the ice to stop the cooking.
Drain the asparagus and halve the hearts of palm lengthways.
Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, a squeeze of the second lemon and the hot sauce.
Serve the asparagus and hearts of palm on the rest of the ice with the sauce.

veg.n: Antipasto for two with chargrilled eggplant
veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours ahead, covered in the fridge

ingredients.item: red capsicums, roasted and cut into strips

steps.text: Fold the eggplant and provolone onto a board.
Add the stuffed peppers, olives, artichoke hearts and strips of roasted capsicum.
Tear the bread and set it beside the board. Serve by candlelight.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Whisk the agar and sugar into the coconut milk in a saucepan.
Bring to the boil and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring.
Pour into glasses and chill until set, about 1 hour.
Toast the shredded coconut in a dry pan.
Dice the mango and top the puddings with mango and toasted coconut.
Spread a cloth on the floor or table.
Cut the cheddar into wedges and slice the apples.
Tear the bread.
Lay everything out with the pasties and pickled onions for everyone to help themselves.
